252: Redeeming captives precedes poor people [in regards to tzedakah] and in clothing them. There is not mitzvah greater than redeeming captives, therefore in regard to any mitzvah for which money was collected, we can reappropriate these funds to redeeming captives, even if they were collected for the needs of building a synagogue. Even if they [already] bought wood, stones, and cut them to the needs of construction, it would be forbidden to sell these for the sake of another mitzvah but it is permitted to sell them for the need of redeeming captives. But, if they already built it [the synagogue] they should not sell them.
